tagline: Ihagee胶片单反相机，1929 年发布
description: Ihagee于1929年推出的胶片单反相机。

specs.英文简介: The Nachtreflex (Night Reflex; named in English-language catalogues as Nocturnal Reflex Camera[http://www.ihagee.org/cat/IHGcat1930-31-4.pdf Ihagee catalogue in four languages including English] for 1930-31, p.83; at ihagee.org) is an SLR camera, made by Ihagee to exploit the low-light capability of the very fast Plasmat lenses designed by Paul Rudolph for Meyer: a competitor to the Ermanox Reflex
